name: What should I do first before garage flooring installation?

mainEntity.name: What should I do first before garage flooring installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Start by getting the concrete inspected for cracks, moisture issues, and any prior coatings so the installer can recommend the right system. For most garages in the Denver area, a professional will also explain whether epoxy or polyaspartic is the better fit for your floor, based on sun exposure, temperature swings, and how you use the space. A good estimate should include prep, repairs, coating type, and cure time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get the concrete inspected first. The installer should check cracks, moisture, and old coatings before recommending epoxy or polyaspartic.
